name: Teamwork Animal Archetypes Assessment Dataset
description: A balanced dataset of 40 easy-to-answer multiple-choice questions for a teamwork and project-oriented animal archetype assessment. Each answer includes weighted affinity scores for six animal species. Scores are relative and can be summed across responses.

scoring_notes.scale: Each answer provides affinity scores from 0 to 3 for each species.
scoring_notes.interpretation: Higher scores indicate stronger alignment with that species archetype in collaborative work and project settings.
scoring_notes.usage: For each selected answer, add the associated scores to cumulative totals for each species.

archetype_summaries.meerkat: Alert, cooperative, communicative, and quick to coordinate with the group.
archetype_summaries.sloth: Calm, steady, thoughtful, patient, and resistant to unnecessary rush.
archetype_summaries.wolf: Goal-driven, decisive, strategic, and comfortable leading a coordinated effort.
archetype_summaries.dolphin: Social, creative, energizing, adaptive, and strong at group morale.
archetype_summaries.beaver: Practical, reliable, organized, and focused on building solid outcomes.
archetype_summaries.owl: Analytical, observant, careful, and focused on clarity, logic, and quality.
